description.value: The Watson is a neighbourhood cocktail bar in the heart of Mount Pleasant on Main Street, created by the team behind Bartholomew bar in Yaletown. It features inventive, expertly crafted cocktails alongside elevated bar food and hearty comfort dishes. There is a sun-drenched patio and a mezzanine lounge, making it a welcoming stop along one of Vancouver's main north-south cycling corridors.
